task1.title: Task 1 - Data & Chart Report
task1.prompt:
The chart below shows the percentage of households in different income brackets that owned consumer electronics in 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

task2.title: Task 2 - Essay Argument
task2.prompt:
Some people believe that university education should be entirely free for all eligible students. Others argue that students should pay for their higher education because it benefits them personally.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

task1.title: Task 1 - Process Diagram
task1.prompt:
The diagram illustrates the process of recycling plastic bottles to produce high-grade polyester fabric for apparel.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

task2.title: Task 2 - Essay Argument
task2.prompt:
In many modern cities, an increasing number of young adults are choosing to live alone rather than with family or partners.

What are the primary causes of this trend, and does it bring more advantages or disadvantages to society?

Write at least 250 words.

task1.title: Task 1 - Map Comparison
task1.prompt:
The two maps show the layout of the coastal town of Harwich in 1995 and after recent developments today.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main changes.

Write at least 150 words.

task2.title: Task 2 - Essay Argument
task2.prompt:
With the rise of artificial intelligence and automation, some argue that human creativity and critical thinking are diminishing.

To what extent do you agree or disagree with this view?

Write at least 250 words.
